newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain union says agreed '97 wage rise average 3pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain union says agreed '97 wage rise average 3pct.

text.p: Spanish wage agreements for 1997 point to an average three percent rise according to data collected by the General Workers' Union (UGT), a spokesman said on Monday.
The data are based on 22 sectoral pacts affecting 800,000 workers, and other company agreements which apply to 200,000 employees, he said.
Average agreements in 1996 were for a 3.8 percent wage increase.
The Bank of Spain and the government have called for wage moderation so that Spain can reach its 2.6 percent 1997 inflation goal.
Spanish inflation stood at 3.5 percent year-on-year in October, versus 3.6 percent in September.
